stem: An 18-month-old has a minor head injury with an occipital scalp haematoma and vomiting but is currently alert and haemodynamically stable. What is the most appropriate initial management?
explanation: A young child with vomiting and a scalp haematoma after head injury needs risk stratification and observation with serial neurological assessments when not clearly requiring immediate imaging or intervention.
